===To Lithkren!===
'''Items required:''' ''8 [[oak plank]]s, 10 [[swamp paste]], at least 12 [[nail]]s, a [[hammer]] and a [[saw]].'' {{Checklist|
*Bring 8 [[oak plank]]s, 10 [[swamp paste]], 12 [[nail]]s (more may be needed as you may bend them), a [[hammer]], and a [[saw]] to the west side of the island (on the coast just south-west of the "Mushroom Meadow" [[Magic Mushtree]]) and build a rowboat.
*Talk to Dallas Jones and board the boat. {{Chat option|1I'm ready.}}
*Head north-west from the boat to the ruined courtyard, and climb up the western stairs.
*Climb down the [[trapdoor (Lithkren)|trapdoor]] to the south, down the staircase to the north, and north down another staircase.
*Talk to Dallas Jones.
*Search the skeleton to the east and read [[Aivas' diary]].
*Talk to Dallas Jones again.
}}
